kernel_of_truth.description: The latitude coincidence between the Roaring 40s and the SAA southern boundary is real, and remains the dome model's only genuine empirical anchor for this WIN (data/wins.json:024 detail_evidence — IGRF/WMM 32,000 nT contour at sea level places SAA southern edge at ~45-50°S, overlapping the Roaring 40s ~40-50°S band). The post-patch text continues to acknowledge this honestly (paragraph 1 unchanged from c4).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Verified post-patch: the longitude-mismatch refutation is now strengthened by two new preemptive moves (data/wins.json:024 paragraph 2). First, the symmetric/asymmetric rim-pressure dilemma forecloses the WIN-030 + WIN-032 escape route — granting the dome's own elliptical disc + New Jerusalem axis hypotheses, the dilemma still bites because asymmetric rim pressure breaks wind-belt uniformity and symmetric rim pressure breaks SAA localization. Second, the Northern-Hemisphere Westerlies control argument — wind belts at 40-50°N exist at all ocean longitudes but weaken over North America and Eurasia — is exactly what Ferrel cell + continental friction predicts and what no disc-edge-pressure model predicts. The kernel-of-truth latitude match now stands alone against a three-layered refutation (longitude mismatch + asymmetry-dilemma + NH control); the post-hoc-standard hook in detail_verdict_text adds the methodological refutation.

advocate_mode.best_defense: A determined dome defender might pivot to a multi-mechanism dome: "The Roaring 40s have rim-pressure as one component overlaid on Ferrel-cell circulation; the SAA reflects the rim-pressure component alone where continental crust permits magnetic flux passage; the asymmetry between the two is exactly the asymmetry between continental and oceanic crust." This is hand-wavy and untestable but rhetorically possible.
advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: No additional preemption needed. The existing detail_evidence already says "no disc-edge-pressure model predicts" the continental weakening, and the verdict text already says the dome "hardcodes the boundary observation rather than deriving it." Any multi-mechanism rescue collapses the single-cause parsimony that motivated the WIN in the first place, so the defense forfeits the WIN to claim the rescue.
